item.title: Summarise() error - object not found?
item.description:
Hello everyone, I am getting the following error when I try to run my code. That error is: Error in `summarise()`: ℹ In argument: `Median_Strain = median(Strain, na.rm = TRUE)`. Caused by error: ! object 'Strain' not found
I am using the following code:
library(tidyverse) library(cowplot) library(scales) library(readxl) library(ggpubr) library(ggpattern)
file_path <- "C:/Users/LookHere/ExampleData.xlsx"
sheets <- excel_sheets(file_path)
result <- lapply(sheets, function(sheet) { data <- read_excel(file_path, sheet = sheet)
data %>% group_by(Side) %>% filter(Strain <= quantile(Strain, 0.95)) %>% summarise(Mean_Strain = mean(Strain, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% summarise(Median_Strain = median(Strain, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% filter(Shear <= quantile(Shear, 0.95)) %>% summarise(Mean_Shear = mean(Shear, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% summarise(Median_Shear = median(Shear, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% ungroup() %>% mutate(Sheet = sheet) }) final_result <- bind_rows(result)
write.csv(final_result, "ExampleData_strain_results_FromBottom95%Strains.csv", row.names = FALSE)
Any idea what is causing this error and how to fix it? The "Strain" object is definitely in my data.
